description: Defines a template class ScopedGeneric for resource management with custom deleters, similar to unique_ptr but for objects with an 'invalid' value. Includes traits for handling resource cleanup.

classes.name: ScopedGeneric
classes.description: A template class managing resources with custom traits, supporting move semantics, reset, swap, release, and validity checks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Releases current resource and assigns a new value, aborting if the new value is the same as the current.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps resources with another ScopedGeneric instance.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the resource and returns it, setting internal value to invalid.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Resets the resource and returns a pointer to internal storage for out-parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the managed object.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the managed object is valid (not equal to invalid value).

methods.name: get_traits
methods.description: Returns a reference to the traits object.
